summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $1.9 billion auto-loan ABS offering via Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-D Owner Trust, backed by fixed-rate retail installment contracts and related security interests. Six note classes price from 4.301% to 5.40%, plus a floating SOFR+0.36% tranche and a 0.00% Class B; proceeds to depositor total roughly $1.756 billion after about $3.3 million in underwriting discounts. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account, overcollateralization, excess interest, and subordination. First payment is November 16, 2026. This is a routine term securitization, not a special situation.
